Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This 
document outlines the steps for testing polarity for current 
transformer I1 which must be performed when enter 
service and when making capital maintenance
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Sabry Shabaan Abd el-Latif, and tested by eng. Sherif Mahrous 
and eng. Hani Bassuonin accepted by t echnical expert eng. Hassan 
elbehiry and approved by eng. Fathy El sayed head sector of El-kureimat power 
station and general manager of inspection and quality control sector eng. Gamal 
Abd El wahab
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
Current transformer isolation and proper earthing is required
A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
Current transformer isolation and proper earthing is required
Tools and Equipment
A center zero voltammeter
Battery 48 volt
Test leads
A center zero voltammeter
Battery 48 volt
Test leads
Work to be Carried Out
Connect the secondary of current transformer to zero voltammeter see fig (1)
Touch the primary of current transformer to battery see fig (1)
The deflection of pointer should be similar in case of each current 
 transformer to be connected in the same protection
If the deflection not similar to the current transformer in the same 
 protection you must reverse the connection of the secondary
Figure (1) Flick Test
Main transformer T1 500/220/11kv
Spare phase
C.T. polarity test
Neutral C.T
C.T ratio : 1500/1A
Primary P1 - P2
Secondary S1 - S3
The positive of the battery is applied to P1 and the push button is pressed 
the pointer of the avometer is right deflected
